verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS commerce platform and its developer tooling (Catalyst, Stencil, SDKs), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out control; the items cover APIs, storefront frameworks, webhooks, sandboxes and marketing pages only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
